description: Telnet protocol must be disabled across all devices.
SSH v2 must be enabled for secure remote management.
Guest Wi-Fi traffic must be strictly isolated from internal networks.
Clinical and Guest VLANs must not share subnet segment or tags.
Logging must be enabled and set to centralized syslog server.
NTP time synchronization must be enabled.
Encryption must be enabled for all wireless and WAN traffic.
HTTPS must be enforced for admin web portals.
Medical IoT devices must be isolated on VLAN 300-399.
Firewall policies must enforce explicit default deny rule.
Legacy SNMP v1/v2c disabled, SNMP v3 mandatory.
BPDU Guard must be active on access ports.
DHCP Snooping must prevent rogue DHCP servers.
Complex password policy enforced on local accounts.
Nightly configuration backup must be enabled.
